E-APP-001.user_message: No connection. Reconnect to continue. Your last tap was not saved.
E-APP-001.what_happened: The performer app tried to send a tap (or load today's list) while the device had no connection, or the request failed at the network level before reaching the server.
E-APP-001.likely_cause: The phone or computer lost its connection.
E-APP-001.fix_hint: Reconnect and tap again. Nothing was queued on purpose — the MVP has no offline mode, so a queued tap could silently go stale.

E-APP-002.user_message: That didn't save. Tap again. Reference: {ref}.
E-APP-002.what_happened: A tap reached the server (or the request otherwise failed) but did not come back with a clear answer — a 500, a timeout, or a response the app could not parse.
E-APP-002.likely_cause: A transient server problem, or a bug in the endpoint being called.
E-APP-002.fix_hint: Tapping again is safe — the log row and the task's status are written together, so a failed attempt leaves neither, and a repeat with the same client_event_id is a no-op if the first one actually landed. If this repeats, check the Health page for a matching failure event.

E-APP-003.what_happened: A performer tried to act on a step that isn't scheduled to them, or asked for a step id that doesn't belong to their account.
E-APP-003.likely_cause: The step was reassigned, the link was stale, or the id belongs to someone else's work.
E-APP-003.fix_hint: Reload today's list. If the step really should be theirs, check the assignment in the plan.

E-APP-004.what_happened: The stored session token was missing, expired, or rejected by the server.
E-APP-004.likely_cause: The session expired, or the token was revoked.
E-APP-004.fix_hint: Sign in again. Nothing from before the expiry was lost — every tap up to that point was already recorded.

E-APP-005.user_message: Something went wrong. Reference: {ref}. We've recorded it.
E-APP-005.what_happened: An error the app did not anticipate — an unhandled exception in the performer screen, or a response shape it didn't expect.
E-APP-005.likely_cause: A bug, or a backend response that changed shape.
E-APP-005.fix_hint: Quote the Reference on the Health page to find the exact event. The screen recovers to a safe empty state rather than staying crashed.

E-DEL-001.user_message: Something is using this map, so it can’t be deleted.
E-DEL-001.what_happened: A journey map was deleted while a plan, a template or a job still depended on it.
E-DEL-001.likely_cause: The map was attached to a plan or template earlier, or work was already created from it.
E-DEL-001.fix_hint: The message names what is using it. Remove the map there first, or leave it in place — an unused map can always be deleted later. Deleting it anyway would leave that plan pointing at a map that no longer exists.
E-DEL-001.message_varies_why: The sentence names the plan or template that is using the map.

E-DEL-002.user_message: Only the person who created this map, or an account admin, can delete it.
E-DEL-002.what_happened: Someone tried to delete a map they do not own and is not an admin for.
E-DEL-002.likely_cause: Maps belonging to the whole account became visible to everyone on 2026-10-17, so a teammate’s map now appears in your list.
E-DEL-002.fix_hint: Ask the person who created it, or an account admin. You can still open and read the map — only deleting it is restricted.

E-GOV-001.user_message: You don't have access to this.
E-GOV-001.what_happened: Someone tried to read or change something that belongs to a different account.
E-GOV-001.likely_cause: A stale link or bookmark pointing at another account's data, or a bug passing the wrong id.
E-GOV-001.fix_hint: Check the Health page timeline for this Reference to see which entity and account were involved. If it keeps happening for a real user, a screen is probably loading an id it shouldn't have.

E-GOV-002.user_message: Those two things belong to different accounts, so they can't be linked.
E-GOV-002.what_happened: An action tried to connect two records that live in different accounts.
E-GOV-002.likely_cause: A picker or form offered an option from outside the current account.
E-GOV-002.fix_hint: Find the two entity ids on the Health page timeline for this Reference, then check which screen offered the cross-account option.

E-GOV-003.user_message: This can't be done while it's in its current state.
E-GOV-003.what_happened: An action was attempted on something whose status doesn't allow it, for example editing a plan that is already live.
E-GOV-003.likely_cause: The screen was showing an out-of-date status, usually because it hadn't been reloaded.
E-GOV-003.fix_hint: Reload the page to see the current status. If the status looks right and the action still fails, check the Health page for the expected states.

E-GOV-004.user_message: This has been archived, so it can't be changed.
E-GOV-004.what_happened: A write was attempted against an archived record.
E-GOV-004.likely_cause: The item was archived in another tab or by someone else since this screen was opened.
E-GOV-004.fix_hint: Reload to confirm it is archived. Archived items are kept for history on purpose and are never edited again.

E-GOV-005.user_message: Someone else changed this. Reload to see the latest.
E-GOV-005.what_happened: Two people edited the same record, and the second save was refused so it couldn't overwrite the first.
E-GOV-005.likely_cause: Two tabs or two people working on the same plan at the same time.
E-GOV-005.fix_hint: Reload and redo the change. Nothing was lost: the refused save was never written.

E-GOV-006.user_message: The daily data check found records pointing at things that no longer exist.
E-GOV-006.what_happened: The integrity audit found rows whose parent record has been deleted — for example journey cells still pointing at a map that is gone — or a stage whose owner key matches no row in its map.
E-GOV-006.likely_cause: Something was deleted without cleaning up what pointed at it. The database does not enforce this on its own, which is why the audit exists.
E-GOV-006.fix_hint: Open the Health page and copy the diagnostic bundle. The counts show which check failed and how often. Orphans are safe to leave in place short-term (nothing reads them), but the delete path that created them needs a guard so it stops happening.

E-JOB-001.user_message: Give the job a short title (up to 120 characters).
E-JOB-001.what_happened: A job was added with no title, a title over 120 characters, or one containing HTML tags.
E-JOB-001.likely_cause: The title box was left empty, or text was pasted in from a web page and brought formatting with it.
E-JOB-001.fix_hint: A job title is how people recognise this piece of work in a list — a customer name or a reference is usually enough. Paste as plain text if you copied it from elsewhere. Your typing was kept.

E-JOB-002.user_message: This plan doesn't use that map. Add it to the plan's maps first.
E-JOB-002.what_happened: A job was added for a journey map the plan does not accept.
E-JOB-002.likely_cause: The plan was created from a template that did not include this map, or the map was added to the template after this plan was made.
E-JOB-002.fix_hint: The full message names the map. A plan's accepted maps are copied from its template when the plan is created, so adding a map to the template later does not reach plans that already exist — add it to this plan directly.

E-JOB-003.user_message: That map hasn't been published yet.
E-JOB-003.what_happened: A job was added for a map that has never had a version published.
E-JOB-003.likely_cause: The map is still a draft.
E-JOB-003.fix_hint: Open the map and publish a version. A job pins itself to the published version it was created from, so there has to be one before any work can be based on it.

E-JOB-004.user_message: That detail isn't valid. Use short text or a number.
E-JOB-004.what_happened: A job detail was rejected: the name used characters other than letters, numbers and underscores, the value was over 200 characters, or the job already has 50 details.
E-JOB-004.likely_cause: A space or punctuation in the detail's name, or a long note pasted into a value.
E-JOB-004.fix_hint: Detail names look like customer_name or order_ref. Long explanations belong in the job's own notes rather than in a detail. Replacing a detail the job already has always works, even at the 50 limit.

E-JOB-005.what_happened: Cancel was called on a job that had already been cancelled.
E-JOB-005.likely_cause: The button was clicked twice, or a request was retried.
E-JOB-005.fix_hint: Nothing went wrong and nothing changed — cancelling twice is harmless. The job's tasks are left exactly as they were, because a cancelled job is still history.

E-LIVE-001.user_message: There's nothing on this timeline to publish.
E-LIVE-001.what_happened: Publish to live was attempted on a day with no work scheduled on it.
E-LIVE-001.likely_cause: The day was created but nothing has been dragged onto it yet.
E-LIVE-001.fix_hint: Schedule at least one piece of work on the day first. Publishing an empty day would show the person an empty list.

E-LIVE-002.user_message: Some steps don't have a person assigned.
E-LIVE-002.what_happened: Publish to live was refused because at least one scheduled step has nobody to do it.
E-LIVE-002.likely_cause: A step was scheduled onto a day without picking who does it, and the day has no default person either.
E-LIVE-002.fix_hint: The full message says how many. Assign someone to each step, or set the day's person. Nothing was published.

E-LIVE-003.user_message: Some steps are marked 'needs info'. Complete them first.
E-LIVE-003.what_happened: Publish to live was refused because at least one step is still waiting on information.
E-LIVE-003.likely_cause: Someone flagged a step as needing information and it has not been resolved.
E-LIVE-003.fix_hint: Open each flagged step, deal with what it is waiting on, and set it back to planned. Sending someone work that is known to be incomplete wastes their time.

E-LIVE-004.user_message: That person doesn't have a login yet, so they can't see their work.
E-LIVE-004.what_happened: Publish to live was refused because an assigned person has no linked login.
E-LIVE-004.likely_cause: The person was added to the plan as a name, without being connected to a user account.
E-LIVE-004.fix_hint: The full message names them. Link their login on the agent, or assign the work to someone who has one. Publishing to a person who cannot sign in would look successful and deliver nothing.

E-LIVE-005.what_happened: Publish to live was attempted on a day that has already been published.
E-LIVE-005.likely_cause: The button was clicked twice, or the day was published from another screen.
E-LIVE-005.fix_hint: Nothing changed. A day is published once — the frozen copy the person sees must not move under them. Later planner changes are recorded separately and stay with the planner.

E-LIVE-006.user_message: We couldn't publish. Nothing was changed.
E-LIVE-006.what_happened: Publishing failed partway and was rolled back.
E-LIVE-006.likely_cause: A database or connection problem during the write.
E-LIVE-006.fix_hint: Try again. The publication and the day's status are written together, so a failure leaves no half-published day. If it keeps happening, copy the diagnostic bundle from the Health page.

E-LOG-001.user_message: That action isn't available for this step right now.
E-LOG-001.what_happened: An action was taken that isn't allowed from the step's current state — for example starting something already finished.
E-LOG-001.likely_cause: The screen was showing an out-of-date state, or someone else moved the step first.
E-LOG-001.fix_hint: The full message says what state the step is in and what to do instead — usually reopening it, or unblocking it first. Nothing was recorded.

E-LOG-002.user_message: Pick a reason so the team knows why.
E-LOG-002.what_happened: A step was marked blocked without choosing a reason.
E-LOG-002.fix_hint: Choose one of the four reasons. A blocked step with no reason tells the planner there is a problem but nothing about what to chase, which is barely better than not flagging it.

E-LOG-003.user_message: This step isn't assigned to you.
E-LOG-003.what_happened: Someone tried to record progress on work that belongs to another person.
E-LOG-003.likely_cause: A stale link, or the work was reassigned after the screen loaded.
E-LOG-003.fix_hint: Refresh your list. If the work really is yours, ask the planner to reassign it to you — the record needs to show who actually did it.

E-LOG-004.user_message: Your tap wasn't saved. Please try again.
E-LOG-004.what_happened: Recording an action failed and was rolled back.
E-LOG-004.likely_cause: A connection or database problem at the moment of the tap.
E-LOG-004.fix_hint: Tap again — repeats are safe, because the same tap is never recorded twice. The log entry and the step's status are written together, so a failure leaves neither. This is the most important write path in the product; repeated failures should be looked at immediately.

E-LOG-005.user_message: Pick one of the listed reasons.
E-LOG-005.what_happened: A blocked step was sent with a reason that isn't one of the four allowed.
E-LOG-005.likely_cause: A client sent its own wording instead of choosing from the list.
E-LOG-005.fix_hint: The reasons are a fixed list so they can be counted and compared across jobs. Free text belongs in the note instead.

E-LOG-006.what_happened: A note was saved with no text.
E-LOG-006.likely_cause: The note box was submitted empty.
E-LOG-006.fix_hint: An empty note was always accepted before APP-2 (US-APP-2-02) added this check — the Step screen's own box also refuses an empty save, but this is the one that actually enforces it.

E-LOG-007.user_message: Notes can be up to 1,000 characters.
E-LOG-007.what_happened: A note was longer than the allowed length.
E-LOG-007.likely_cause: Pasted text, or several notes combined into one.
E-LOG-007.fix_hint: Shorten the note and save again. The typed text is kept on screen, per CLAUDE.md's rule to never discard a rejected save's input.

E-OBS-001.user_message: You don't have access to this page.
E-OBS-001.what_happened: A non-admin user (or an unauthenticated request) tried to reach an ops/* endpoint or the Health page.
E-OBS-001.likely_cause: The caller's user record does not have is_platform_admin set to true.
E-OBS-001.fix_hint: If this user should be a platform admin, set user.is_platform_admin = true directly in the database. There is no UI for this on purpose.

E-OBS-002.user_message: Too many reports were sent in a short time, so we slowed down.
E-OBS-002.what_happened: The client event endpoint's rate limit (20 per minute per user) was hit, usually from a screen stuck in an error loop.
E-OBS-002.likely_cause: A front-end bug is repeatedly failing and reporting the same error.
E-OBS-002.fix_hint: Check the Health page's issue list for the feature/step that is flooding, and fix the underlying front-end error.

E-P3A-001.user_message: This plan has work recorded against it. Archive it instead.
E-P3A-001.what_happened: A delete was refused because the plan already has jobs, a publication or logged activity.
E-P3A-001.likely_cause: Someone tried to delete a plan that has already been used, rather than archiving it.
E-P3A-001.fix_hint: Archive the plan. It disappears from the plan list and stops accepting changes, but everything already recorded against it stays intact. Deleting is only possible for a plan nothing has happened on yet.

E-P3A-002.user_message: This agent has recorded work, so they can't be removed.
E-P3A-002.what_happened: An agent with a published day or logged activity was deleted.
E-P3A-002.likely_cause: Someone tried to remove a person who has already done work.
E-P3A-002.fix_hint: Hide them from the roster instead. Their recorded work still points at them, so the row has to stay.

E-P3A-003.user_message: This timeline is live. It can't be deleted.
E-P3A-003.likely_cause: Someone tried to remove a day that has already been handed to a performer.
E-P3A-003.fix_hint: Publishing freezes a day. Its contents can still be reassigned, but the day itself stays.

E-PLAN-001.user_message: Give the template a unique name (up to 80 characters).
E-PLAN-001.what_happened: A plan template was saved with no name, a name over 80 characters, or a name another template in the same account already uses.
E-PLAN-001.likely_cause: The name was left blank, or a template for this purpose already exists.
E-PLAN-001.fix_hint: Check the template list first — if one already covers this, edit it rather than making a second. Your typing was kept.

E-PLAN-002.user_message: Choose a window between 1 and 366 days.
E-PLAN-002.what_happened: A template's planning window was saved as zero, negative, or longer than a year.
E-PLAN-002.likely_cause: The field was left at zero, or a number of weeks was typed where days were expected.
E-PLAN-002.fix_hint: The window is in days and counts both the first and last day, so a fortnight is 14, not 15.

E-PLAN-003.what_happened: A template's default start time was not a 24-hour HH:MM value.
E-PLAN-003.likely_cause: A single-digit hour ("8:00"), or an hour above 23.
E-PLAN-003.fix_hint: Use two digits for both parts. This is the time each day starts in plans made from this template; it can still be changed per day afterwards.

E-PLAN-004.user_message: Only published maps can be used in a plan.
E-PLAN-004.what_happened: A journey map was attached to a template before it had ever been published.
E-PLAN-004.likely_cause: The map is still a draft, so there is no fixed version of it for a plan to work from.
E-PLAN-004.fix_hint: Open the map and publish a version, then attach it. The full message names the map. Publishing freezes a copy, which is what stops a plan's work changing underneath it later.

E-PLAN-005.user_message: This plan has work recorded against it, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead.
E-PLAN-005.what_happened: A delete was refused because the plan already has jobs, a publication or logged activity.
E-PLAN-005.likely_cause: Someone tried to delete a plan that has already been used.
E-PLAN-005.fix_hint: Archive the plan. It leaves the plan list and stops accepting changes, but everything recorded against it stays intact.

E-PLAN-006.user_message: This person is already set up as an agent.
E-PLAN-006.what_happened: A user was tagged as an agent a second time.
E-PLAN-006.likely_cause: They already have a profile; the create form was submitted again for the same person.
E-PLAN-006.fix_hint: Find their existing profile and edit it instead of creating a new one — one profile per real login.

E-PLAN-007.user_message: Give this AI agent a name.
E-PLAN-007.what_happened: An AI agent profile (no login) was saved with no name.
E-PLAN-007.likely_cause: The name field was left blank — a person profile gets its name from their login, but an AI profile has no login to borrow one from.
E-PLAN-007.fix_hint: Name the AI agent directly, same as naming one inside a plan today.

E-PLAN-008.user_message: Daily capacity must be a positive number of hours.
E-PLAN-008.what_happened: An agent profile's default daily capacity was zero or negative.
E-PLAN-008.likely_cause: The field was left at zero or a negative number was typed.
E-PLAN-008.fix_hint: Enter the usual number of hours this person or AI agent is expected to work in a day — it's only a default, and can still be changed per plan.

E-PLAN-009.what_happened: An agent profile's color wasn't a 6-digit hex value.
E-PLAN-009.likely_cause: A color name or a shorthand 3-digit hex was typed instead of the full 6-digit form.

E-PLAN-010.user_message: This person isn't tagged as an agent right now.
E-PLAN-010.what_happened: A template tried to add an agent profile that's currently marked ineligible.
E-PLAN-010.likely_cause: The profile was toggled off (PLAN-2) after it was last used, or was never fully set up.
E-PLAN-010.fix_hint: Re-enable the agent's profile first, or pick someone else.

E-PLAN-011.user_message: That user isn't on this account.
E-PLAN-011.what_happened: An agent profile was requested for a user outside the caller's account.
E-PLAN-011.likely_cause: A stale or mistaken user id.
E-PLAN-011.fix_hint: Only teammates on this account can be tagged as agents.

E-PLAN-012.user_message: Two agents on this template would both be called the same name. Rename one, or leave one off.
E-PLAN-012.what_happened: An agent was added to a template roster whose display name matches another agent already on it (ignoring capitals and spaces).
E-PLAN-012.likely_cause: An AI agent named like a person, or two people with the same name.
E-PLAN-012.fix_hint: A plan can't hold two agents with the same name, so every plan made from this template would fail. Rename one in the Agents screen, then add it again.

E-PLAN-013.user_message: Only an account admin can set up or change agents for other people, or AI agents.
E-PLAN-013.what_happened: A non-admin tried to tag, untag or edit someone else's agent profile, or an AI agent's.
E-PLAN-013.likely_cause: A member trying to manage the team's agent list.
E-PLAN-013.fix_hint: Members can manage their own profile only. Ask an account admin to make the change.
E-PLAN-013.message_varies_why: Same admin-only rule, worded for create vs edit.

E-PLAN-014.user_message: That template is archived, so new plans can't be made from it.
E-PLAN-014.what_happened: A plan was created from a template that has been archived.
E-PLAN-014.likely_cause: The template was archived after the screen was opened, or an old link was used.
E-PLAN-014.fix_hint: Un-archive the template, or pick a different one. Plans already made from it are unaffected.

E-PLAN-015.user_message: One of those maps isn't available to this account.
E-PLAN-015.what_happened: A map was attached that does not belong to this account.
E-PLAN-015.likely_cause: A stale list, or an id from somewhere else.
E-PLAN-015.fix_hint: Reload the picker. It only offers maps this account owns; anything else is refused server-side.

E-PLAN-016.user_message: One of those agents isn't available to this account.
E-PLAN-016.what_happened: An agent profile was added to a template but does not belong to this account.
E-PLAN-016.likely_cause: A stale list, or an id from somewhere else.
E-PLAN-016.fix_hint: Reload the Agents screen. Only this account’s agents can go on a template roster.

E-PLN-001.user_message: You already have a plan with this name.
E-PLN-001.what_happened: A plan was created or renamed to a name another plan in the same account already uses.
E-PLN-001.likely_cause: Two plans were given the same name, or the same create was submitted twice.
E-PLN-001.fix_hint: Pick a different name. Names only have to be unique within your own account, so another company using the same name is not the problem. Your typing was kept.

E-PLN-002.user_message: The end date can't be before the start date.
E-PLN-002.what_happened: A plan's planning window was saved with its end earlier than its start.
E-PLN-002.likely_cause: One of the two dates was changed without looking at the other.
E-PLN-002.fix_hint: Check both dates. Changing only one of them still has to leave the window the right way round, so the saved value for the other date is what it was compared against.

E-PLN-003.user_message: This has to be zero or more.
E-PLN-003.what_happened: A plan's AI throughput setting was saved as a negative number.
E-PLN-003.likely_cause: A minus sign was typed, or a field was pre-filled with a bad value.
E-PLN-003.fix_hint: Enter zero or a positive number. Zero means the plan makes no AI throughput assumption at all.

E-PLN-004.user_message: You already have a model with this id.
E-PLN-004.what_happened: A model was added using an id another model in the same account already uses.
E-PLN-004.likely_cause: The model was already added, or the id differs only by capitalisation — ids are lower-cased, so "GPT-X" and "gpt-x" are the same id.
E-PLN-004.fix_hint: Check the model list first. If the existing one has the wrong prices, edit it rather than adding a second.

E-PLN-005.user_message: A model's id can't be changed after it's created. Add a new model instead.
E-PLN-005.what_happened: An edit tried to change a model's id.
E-PLN-005.likely_cause: A rename was attempted on the id rather than on the display name.
E-PLN-005.fix_hint: The display name can be changed freely — change that instead. The id is fixed because "reset to defaults" uses it to recognise the built-in models. To really change an id, add a new model and point the agents at it.

E-PLN-006.user_message: This model is still used by some agents. Point them at another model first.
E-PLN-006.what_happened: A model could not be deleted because agents still reference it.
E-PLN-006.likely_cause: The model is assigned to one or more AI agents in a plan.
E-PLN-006.fix_hint: The full message names each agent using the model. Open each one and pick a different model, then delete this one. Nothing was deleted.

E-PLN-007.user_message: This plan already has someone with that name.
E-PLN-007.what_happened: An agent was added or renamed to a name another agent in the same plan already uses.
E-PLN-007.likely_cause: Two people with the same first name, or the same person added twice.
E-PLN-007.fix_hint: Use something that tells them apart, like a surname or initial. Names only have to be unique inside one plan, so the same name is fine in a different plan. Your typing was kept.

E-PLN-008.user_message: Only AI agents can have a model.
E-PLN-008.what_happened: A model was assigned to an agent whose kind is "person".
E-PLN-008.likely_cause: The kind was switched to person without clearing the model, or the wrong agent was being edited.
E-PLN-008.fix_hint: A model is only used to work out token costs, which only apply to AI agents. Either switch this agent to AI, or leave the model unset. Switching an AI agent to a person clears its model automatically.

E-PLN-009.user_message: Daily capacity has to be more than 0 and no more than 24 hours.
E-PLN-009.what_happened: An agent's daily capacity was saved outside the range a day allows.
E-PLN-009.likely_cause: A zero, a negative number, or a value above 24 was entered.
E-PLN-009.fix_hint: Enter the hours this person or agent is available on a normal day. Zero would mean they can never be scheduled, so use hide instead if that is what you want.

E-PLN-010.user_message: Enter a start time as HH:MM, between 00:00 and 23:59.
E-PLN-010.what_happened: A timeline's start time was saved in a format the planner could not read.
E-PLN-010.likely_cause: A single-digit hour or minute ("8:5"), a 24-hour value above 23, or the field left blank.
E-PLN-010.fix_hint: Use two digits for both parts, like 08:00 or 14:30. Your typing was kept.

E-PLN-011.user_message: A timeline's status is set by publishing, not here.
E-PLN-011.what_happened: A create or edit tried to set a timeline's status directly.
E-PLN-011.likely_cause: A client sent the whole timeline object back, including its status, instead of just the fields being changed.
E-PLN-011.fix_hint: Status only ever changes when a plan is published to live. Leave it out of the request. Nothing was saved.

E-PLN-012.user_message: That agent already has a timeline on that date.
E-PLN-012.what_happened: A timeline was dragged onto a day where that agent already has one.
E-PLN-012.likely_cause: The target cell looked empty, or two people were editing the schedule at once.
E-PLN-012.fix_hint: One person gets one timeline per day. Move it to a free day, or open the existing timeline and move the tasks across. Nothing was changed, and the two days were not merged.

E-PLN-013.user_message: How long should this take? Enter between 1 minute and 24 hours.
E-PLN-013.what_happened: A task's duration was saved as zero, negative, or longer than a day.
E-PLN-013.likely_cause: The field was left at zero, or a number of hours was typed where minutes were expected.
E-PLN-013.fix_hint: Durations are in minutes, so an hour and a half is 90. A task longer than a day should be split into several. Your typing was kept.

E-PLN-014.user_message: Say what's missing, so whoever picks this up knows what to chase.
E-PLN-014.what_happened: A task was flagged as needing information, with no explanation of what is needed.
E-PLN-014.likely_cause: The status was changed without filling in the reason box.
E-PLN-014.fix_hint: Write a short note about what you are waiting on. Setting the task back to planned clears the note automatically.

E-PLN-015.what_happened: A task was moved to a negative position in a list.
E-PLN-015.likely_cause: A drag-and-drop sent a bad index — this is a bug in the screen, not something typed.
E-PLN-015.fix_hint: Dropping past the end of a list is fine and lands the task at the end. A negative position means the caller computed the drop point wrongly. Nothing was moved.

E-PLN-016.user_message: That new order doesn't match this day's tasks, so nothing was changed.
E-PLN-016.what_happened: A reorder was sent that did not list exactly the tasks currently on that day — one was missing, repeated, or did not belong.
E-PLN-016.likely_cause: The day changed in another tab or by someone else while this screen was open.
E-PLN-016.fix_hint: Reload the day and drag again. The order was left exactly as it was — a partial reorder is never applied.

E-PLN-017.user_message: That login doesn't belong to this account.
E-PLN-017.what_happened: An agent was linked to a login from a different account.
E-PLN-017.likely_cause: The person was removed from the account after the screen was opened.
E-PLN-017.fix_hint: Pick someone from this account’s own list. An agent can only be performed by a login that belongs here.

E-PLN-018.user_message: That login is already linked to someone else in this plan.
E-PLN-018.what_happened: Two agents in one plan were pointed at the same login.
E-PLN-018.likely_cause: The same person added twice under different names.
E-PLN-018.fix_hint: One login, one agent, per plan — otherwise their day would arrive twice. Unlink the other agent first.

E-PUB-001.user_message: This map isn't ready yet. Open the checklist to see what needs attention.
E-PUB-001.what_happened: Publish was refused because the map did not pass the readiness gate.
E-PUB-001.likely_cause: Something on the checklist is still missing: a title, a stage owner, a task, or an expected duration.
E-PUB-001.fix_hint: Open the checklist on the map. Every unticked item is a thing to fill in. Nothing was published and nothing was lost.

E-PUB-003.user_message: This saved version doesn't match its own record. Someone should look into it.
E-PUB-003.what_happened: A published version's stored content no longer matches the fingerprint taken when it was published.
E-PUB-003.likely_cause: The row was changed outside the publish path: a direct database edit, a restore gone wrong, or tampering.
E-PUB-003.fix_hint: Do not edit the row. Copy the diagnostic bundle from the Health page. Published versions are meant to be permanent and unchangeable, so a mismatch means something wrote to the table directly and that write needs finding.

E-PUB-004.user_message: You don't have access to this map.
E-PUB-004.what_happened: Someone asked for a map's readiness or published versions while not being its owner.
E-PUB-004.likely_cause: A stale link or bookmark pointing at someone else's map, or a bug passing the wrong map id.
E-PUB-004.fix_hint: Check the Health page timeline for this Reference to see which map and user were involved. If it keeps happening for a real user, a screen is loading an id it shouldn't have.

E-PUB-005.user_message: This map is archived and can't be published.
E-PUB-005.what_happened: Publish was refused because the map's status is archived.
E-PUB-005.likely_cause: The map was archived earlier, and a page left open still shows its Publish button.
E-PUB-005.fix_hint: Un-archive the map first if it should still be in use. Nothing was published.

E-SCHED-001.user_message: This step is already on the schedule.
E-SCHED-001.what_happened: A job step was scheduled when it already had a slot, or belongs to a cancelled job.
E-SCHED-001.likely_cause: The backlog was open in two places, or the step was scheduled a moment ago from another screen.
E-SCHED-001.fix_hint: Reload the backlog — a step that is already scheduled disappears from it. Each step gets one slot, so the same work can never be given out twice.

E-SCHED-002.user_message: Enter a duration between 1 and 1,440 minutes.
E-SCHED-002.what_happened: A scheduled duration was saved as zero, negative, fractional, or longer than a day.
E-SCHED-002.likely_cause: The field was cleared, or hours were typed where minutes were expected.
E-SCHED-002.fix_hint: Durations are whole minutes, so two hours is 120. Something longer than a day should be split across days. Your typing was kept.

E-SCHED-003.user_message: Someone else changed this. Reload to see the latest.
E-SCHED-003.what_happened: A duration was saved against a value that had already moved on — someone else edited the same slot first.
E-SCHED-003.likely_cause: Two people planning the same day at once, or the same plan open in two tabs.
E-SCHED-003.fix_hint: Reload and make the change again. Nothing was lost: the refused save was never written, and the other person's change is intact.

E-SCHED-005.user_message: Pick a reason from the list or choose 'Other'.
E-SCHED-005.what_happened: A duration was changed with a reason that is not one of the job's own details.
E-SCHED-005.likely_cause: The detail the reason referred to was renamed or removed after the form was opened.
E-SCHED-005.fix_hint: Reasons point at one of the job's recorded details so the change can be explained later. If none fits, choose Other. Giving no reason at all is also fine.

E-SCHED-006.user_message: That day is already live, so this step can't be taken off it.
E-SCHED-006.what_happened: A job step was unscheduled from a day that has already been published.
E-SCHED-006.likely_cause: The day was published after the step was placed on it, and the planner changed their mind afterwards.
E-SCHED-006.fix_hint: Publishing freezes a day and hands it to the person doing the work, so its contents can't be pulled back out. Nothing is lost: the step is still there, and the performer can skip it with a reason if it shouldn't be done.

E-SCHED-007.user_message: Work has already been recorded on this step, so it can't be unscheduled.
E-SCHED-007.what_happened: A job step was unscheduled after it had been started, finished, blocked, skipped, or had a note left on it.
E-SCHED-007.likely_cause: Someone began the work between the step being scheduled and the planner changing their mind.
E-SCHED-007.fix_hint: Removing the slot would orphan what was already recorded against it. The step can still be moved to a different day, and the person doing it can skip it with a reason.

E-SCHED-008.user_message: That job is cancelled, so its steps can't be scheduled.
E-SCHED-008.what_happened: A step from a cancelled job was scheduled onto a day.
E-SCHED-008.likely_cause: The job was cancelled while the backlog was open.
E-SCHED-008.fix_hint: Reload the backlog — a cancelled job’s steps drop out of it. Its history stays, but it is no longer work waiting to happen.

E-STAGE-001.user_message: Pick an owner from this map's rows.
E-STAGE-001.what_happened: A stage was saved with an owner that is not one of the rows on that map.
E-STAGE-001.likely_cause: The owner picker was showing a row from a different map, usually because the page was left open while the map changed.
E-STAGE-001.fix_hint: Reload the map and pick the owner again. If the right row genuinely isn't in the list, add it to the map first.

E-TIME-001.user_message: Enter how long this takes as a number, like 15.
E-TIME-001.what_happened: A duration value was missing, negative, or not a number.
E-TIME-001.likely_cause: The field was left as text, or a negative number was typed.
E-TIME-001.fix_hint: Enter a number of 0 or more.

E-TIME-002.user_message: Pick a unit: minutes, hours, days or weeks.
E-TIME-002.what_happened: A duration unit was missing or not one of the four allowed units.
E-TIME-002.likely_cause: The unit picker was left unset, or a direct API call sent an unexpected value.
E-TIME-002.fix_hint: Choose one of the listed units.

E-TIME-003.user_message: Add both a number and a unit, or leave both empty.
E-TIME-003.what_happened: Only one of the duration value and unit was filled in.
E-TIME-003.likely_cause: A number was typed without picking a unit, or a unit was picked without a number.
E-TIME-003.fix_hint: Fill in both fields, or clear both to leave the duration unset.

E-VAL-001.what_happened: A required field was left empty or contained only whitespace.
E-VAL-001.likely_cause: The field was skipped, or only spaces were typed into it.
E-VAL-001.fix_hint: Fill in the field and try again. Your other entries were kept.
E-VAL-001.message_varies_why: Generic "required" code: the sentence names the field.

E-VAL-002.what_happened: A value was longer than the field allows.
E-VAL-002.likely_cause: Pasted text, or a very long sentence where a short label was expected.
E-VAL-002.fix_hint: Shorten the value to the field's limit.
E-VAL-002.message_varies_why: Generic "too long" code: the sentence names the field and its limit.

E-VAL-003.what_happened: A number, date or time was not in a valid format, or a number was outside its allowed range.
E-VAL-003.likely_cause: A typo, or a value copied from somewhere with a different format.
E-VAL-003.fix_hint: Check the expected format or range and try again.

E-VAL-004.user_message: That isn't one of the allowed options.
E-VAL-004.what_happened: A value was outside the fixed list this field accepts.
E-VAL-004.likely_cause: A direct API call, or stale choices in an old browser tab.
E-VAL-004.fix_hint: Pick one of the listed options and try again.
E-VAL-004.message_varies_why: Generic "not an allowed value" code: the sentence names the rule.

E-VAL-005.user_message: That can't contain formatting like that.
E-VAL-005.what_happened: A value looked like it contained an HTML tag, which this field does not allow.
E-VAL-005.likely_cause: Text copied from a web page or rich-text editor brought formatting codes with it.
E-VAL-005.fix_hint: Paste as plain text, or remove the angle-bracket formatting.

E-VAL-006.what_happened: A name that must be unique already exists.
E-VAL-006.likely_cause: Someone already created something with this name (matching is case- and space-insensitive).
E-VAL-006.fix_hint: Pick a different name, or find and use the existing one.

E-VAL-007.what_happened: A reference pointed at something that doesn't exist, is archived, or belongs to a different account.
E-VAL-007.likely_cause: A stale link, or something that was archived or deleted after this screen loaded.
E-VAL-007.fix_hint: Reload and try again. If it keeps happening, the Health page timeline for this Reference will show which entity was involved.
E-VAL-007.message_varies_why: Generic "not found" code: the sentence names the thing.
